title: Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan donate $4 million to save 600-year-old Hawaii fishpond
content: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have contributed $4 million for the preservation of Alakoko Fishpond in Hawaii. This historic site, which is over 600 years old, faced potential environmental degradation and development pressure. The donation helped acquire the property for long-term stewardship by the nonprofit Mālama Hulē‘ia. Their initiative supports education about traditional Hawaiian aquaculture and native ecosystems.

title: Trade irony amid Trump threat: Why Russia is buying its own oil as fuel from India
content: The underlying issue is not Russia's access to crude oil but its ability to convert crude into usable fuels.  Refinery outages and infrastructure disruptions have constrained domestic production, forcing Russia to import products such as gasoline. In terms of magnitude, Russia’s import volume of oil products is not colossal. However, Russia, formerly the world’s largest oil-product exporter, now faces additional logistical costs

title: Nevada volunteers remove 120,125 pounds of waste from Truckee River watershed
content: On September 26, over 575 passionate volunteers dedicated their time to a significant cleanup effort in Nevada's Truckee River watershed. Their hard work resulted in the removal of an astounding 120,125 pounds of waste, which included both litter and invasive weeds. This collaborative initiative also focused on planting vegetation and enhancing storm drains, all aimed at safeguarding the local ecosystem.

title: Delhi bus gang rape: Charge sheet mentions semen, hair strands as key evidence

The minor boarded the bus in Greater Noida believing it was heading to her destination. After the assault, she was dropped near Kashmere Gate, where she reported the incident. Forensic evidence collected from the bus includes semen samples and hair strands.

title: INDIA bloc meet: Opposition to sharpen EC, BJP attack - what's on agenda
content: The INDIA bloc is gathering to address significant concerns regarding the Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision process. This crucial meeting will see opposition parties deliberating on an agitation and a potential motion for the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Key opposition leaders will participate, although some, like the Aam Aadmi Party and DMK, will be absent.

title: Pennsylvania farmer protects 170-acre farm after rejecting two lucrative offers
content: Dairy farmer Jeff Biddle has placed his Bear Meadows Farm under a permanent conservation easement for protection. The decision came after Biddle declined two offers from potential buyers interested in the property. The conservation easement ensures that the farm's agricultural landscape will remain intact without development. Biddle's family has farmed the land since 1959, emphasizing the farm's long-standing history.

title: Ted Turner bought 4,680-acre island to stop development; sold it for $4.9m
content: Ted Turner sold St Phillips Island to the South Carolina government for $4.9 million, much lower than its appraised value. The island will become part of South Carolina's state park system, focusing on ecosystem protection. Public access will be limited, allowing for educational programs and eco-tourism opportunities. Turner initially acquired the island in 1979 to prevent commercial development and has maintained its natural state.

title: Minneapolis residents form cooperative to buy 6 historic Victorian houses
content: Residents of Nicollet Island are taking a united stand to purchase their cherished homes currently up for sale by TCHDC, due to financial strains affecting the nonprofit's ability to manage the properties. To safeguard affordable housing and the community's continuity, the Nicollet Island Cooperative has emerged. They are working alongside Land Bank Twin Cities to establish a buy-back arrangement, ensuring a stable future while negotiations with the property managers continue.

title: Travis Kelce’s childhood rival: How did their bond become family?
content: Travis Kelce and Aric Jones have been inseparable since their childhood days in Cleveland Heights, where they first crossed paths on the youth hockey rink. Their mutual passion for sports led to a strong friendship that flourished throughout high school and persists into their adult lives. After inviting Jones to stay with him in Kansas City, the bond only grew stronger.

title: 2026 NFL season: Why are backup quarterbacks taking center stage?
content: Josh Allen suffered a hard hit to his knee, while Jayden Daniels and Baker Mayfield both dealt with dislocations - Daniels to his elbow and Mayfield to his thumb. Caleb Williams sustained a hamstring injury, Jaxson Dart suffered a season-ending knee injury, and Kyler Murray returned from a concussion. Tua Tagovailoa suited up for Week 3 as backup QB.

title: Fort Kochi’s 300-year-old Koder House completely gutted in fire
content: Koder House, a significant heritage structure in Fort Kochi, suffered complete destruction due to a fire. This building, dating back to 1800s, was connected to the influential Koder family in the local Jewish community. Previously, it functioned as a boutique hotel and hosted cultural events related to Judaism. The incident has highlighted the urgent need for preserving historic buildings in the area.

title: With eye on New Zealand tour, BCCI to issue Ranji Trophy diktat
content: With India's tour of New Zealand set to begin on October 22, the mental preparations have already begun. Ahead of the bumper five T20I, five ODI and two Test series, the key members of the Test squad would be required to play domestic cricket to stay fit and match sharp.

title: US to lend 40m barrel oil from strategic reserve as Ukraine war strains supply
content: The United States has proposed a loan of 40 million barrels of oil from its Strategic Petroleum Reserve to energy companies. This initiative is designed to counteract rising oil prices, which have been significantly impacted by the conflicts in Ukraine and Iran. As Indian refiners brace for a decline in Russian oil supplies, competition with China is pushing them toward pricier oil options.

title: 'No locus standi': India rejects Turkey president's remarks on Kashmir at UNGA
content: Ministry of External Affairs criticised Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan for raising the Kashmir issue at the UN. The MEA emphasized that no external party has a right to comment on India's territorial integrity. Erdogan suggested dialogue to resolve disputes, including the Kashmir issue, within the United Nations framework. India has consistently maintained that Jammu and Kashmir is an integral part of the nation.

title: How Russia's ballistic missiles, jet-powered drones have kept Ukraine under pressure
content: Reports indicate that Russia is intensifying its attacks on Ukraine, targeting key cities with ballistic missiles and drones. As Ukraine grapples with a lack of US-made Patriot missiles, the capability of its air defenses is being severely tested. Ukrainian officials claim that these strikes are a strategic move by Russia to weaken their defense.

title: FIFA hits back at UEFA: Infantino's lawyers accuse European body of 'harassment'

title: Watch: 2 girls, auto driver exchange blows on Bengaluru road over fare dispute

The public video captures both sides exchanging blows until another girl intervened to stop the altercation. The police contacted the girls after the video circulated on social media, urging them to file a complaint. The auto driver alleged that he was assaulted after the girls refused to pay for their ride.

title: Essex farm flooded with seawater helped double saltmarsh across Thames estuary
content: In October 2002, a sea wall breach in Essex transformed farmland into a coastal wetland, increasing saltmarsh areas. This project, supported by various environmental organizations, aimed to restore natural habitats and manage coastal erosion. Marine life flourished, and biodiversity increased rapidly in the newly flooded areas after the breach. Traditional farming on higher land continued alongside saltmarsh restoration, contributing to sustainable agriculture.

title: Asian Games Medal Tally: How two gold medals lifted India back into the top 10
content: India secured two gold medals on Day 10 of the Asian Games, enhancing its overall medal tally to 53. Neeru Dhanda won India's first gold in women's trap shooting, setting an Asian Games record. The women's 4x400m relay team also clinched gold, adding to India's success in athletics. Additionally, India achieved multiple bronze medals in various events, showcasing its competitiveness.

title: HM launches PRAGATI-50 initiative to establish cleaning benchmark for Indian cities

These cities will implement focused strategies and be closely monitored within the Swachh Bharat Mission–Urban 2.0 framework. Union Minister Manohar Lal will chair regular reviews to ensure consistent progress. The initiative encourages active citizen involvement, urging states and local authorities to create actionable plans for timely implementation.

title: 30-something heart: Inside a threefold spike striking young India
content: A significant increase in cardiovascular diseases is noted among younger Indians, impacting populations previously thought healthy. A recent survey indicates a threefold rise in heart-related ailments from 2017-2018 to 2025. Conditions like hypertension and diabetes are contributing factors for this rise. Unforeseen heart issues are emerging in individuals with no prior risk factors, showcasing a concerning trend. Urgent medical interventions are increasingly required for younger patients facing severe cardiac conditions.

title: Texas mogul paid $36m for 1963 Coral Gables home, then demolished it

The estate, designed by Alfred Browning Parker, was not designated as a historic landmark. Local preservation advocates expressed frustration over regulatory loopholes allowing such demolitions without public hearings. The demolition reflects a broader trend driven by rising land values in South Florida’s luxury real estate market.

title: Meet Ishaan Dokania, sixth-grader whose AI model spots lithium with 89% accuracy
content: Ishaan Dokania, a sixth-grader from Oregon, is exploring lithium resource identification using satellite imagery and machine learning. His project reached 89% accuracy in predicting potential lithium deposits after addressing data noise and testing various algorithms. Ishaan's innovative approach combines geology and remote sensing to streamline mineral exploration. He is competing as a finalist in the 2026 Thermo Fisher Scientific Junior Innovators Challenge.

title: New NCERT book says Indian kings got swords from goddesses to resist invasions

It emphasizes the cultural worship of deities like Kali and Durga for protection during conflicts, documents invasions from the seventh century, and highlights the valor of Indian rulers against foreign aggressors. This resource aims to enhance analytical thinking and foster intercultural dialogue among secondary students.

title: On cam: Military aircraft crashes in Russia due to 'fuel explosion'; 6 dead
content:
Russian defence ministry Tu-154 crashes in Amur region

A Russian ministry aircraft crashed near the village of Krasnoyanovo in the Amur region on Tuesday, killing six people, according several local media reports. Seven people were reportedly on board the Tu-154 aircraft, with one survivor sustaining injuries and being hospitalised. Preliminary information suggested the crash may have been caused by a "fuel explosion" on board. A large fire broke out at the crash site following the incident. Several videos of the aircraft after the crash was circulated on social media. An investigation into the cause of the crash is underway.

title: 15k Ladakh-grown Liliums set out for national flower markets

title: A 56-million-year bat mystery may finally have an answer, and it points to Europe
content: new research traces the origins of bats to Europe and suggests powered flight and echolocation evolved remarkably early in their history . researchers have reconstructed a new version of the bat family tree by combining chromosome-level genomes from 103 bat species with fossils and detailed anatomical data .
